description: This file defines types, constants, interfaces, and utility functions for configuring and validating a matrix visualization in the Superset UI, including axis configurations, layout options, and validation logic.

methods.name: getMatrixifyConfig
methods.description: Extracts and returns the Matrixify configuration from form data, or null if not configured.

methods.name: isMatrixifyEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Matrixify is enabled and properly configured based on form data.

methods.name: getMatrixifyValidationErrors
methods.description: Validates the Matrixify configuration in form data and returns a list of error messages.
